title: Amber vendor notice
text: The synthetic Amber vendor agreement requires 30 calendar days of termination notice. Notice must be sent to the contract mailbox.

title: Bravo data return
text: Bravo's data clause requires return or deletion within 45 days after termination. A deletion certificate is required.

title: Cobalt liability cap
text: Cobalt's liability cap equals fees paid during the prior 12 months. Confidentiality breaches are excluded from the cap.

title: Delta dispute venue
text: Delta disputes use arbitration in Phoenix, Arizona. The proceeding uses one arbitrator.

title: Ember renewal term
text: Ember subscriptions renew for one-year terms. Either party may opt out at least 60 days before renewal.

title: Fjord audit rights
text: Fjord permits one compliance audit per calendar year. The requesting party gives 10 business days of notice.

title: Grove assignment rule
text: Grove prohibits assignment without written consent. Assignment to an acquiring affiliate is permitted without consent.

title: Harbor survival period
text: Harbor confidentiality obligations survive for three years after termination. Trade-secret duties survive as long as protected by law.

title: Iris signature process
text: Iris accepts electronic counterparts. Each signed counterpart is treated as an original.

title: Jade order precedence
text: For Jade purchases, an executed order form controls over the master terms for conflicting commercial details.

title: Kite insurance proof
text: Kite suppliers provide insurance certificates each January. The certificate names Kite as an additional insured.

title: Linden publicity consent
text: Linden forbids use of either party's marks without prior written approval. Approval may be revoked in writing.
